properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 22 at 10:50AM PDT until October 22 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS Los Angeles/Oxnard CA
properties.description:
* WHAT...Urban area and small stream flooding caused by excessive
rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Los Angeles County in southwestern
California...

* WHEN...Until 200 PM PDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.
Minor debris flows are possible in the Eaton Burn Scar. Canyon rock
and mud slides possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 1049 AM PDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. This  will cause urban and small stream flooding.
Canyon rock and mud slides and minor debris flows possible.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Acton, Mount Wilson, Pasadena, Alhambra, Glendora, West Covina,
Whittier, Downtown Los Angeles, Altadena, La Canada Flintridge,
Eagle Rock, Glendale, Valyermo, Sierra Madre, Monrovia, Angeles
Crest Highway between Mount Wilson and Mount Waterman, Arcadia,
Azusa, San Gabriel and El Monte.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become
killers in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams or
creeks.

NWSheadline: FLOOD ADVISORY IN EFFECT UNTIL 2 PM PDT THIS AFTERNOON
